fusions.name: Circling Bite
fusions.desc: Bites the target for 9 damage, leaves it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds and [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds, and you heal for 15% of the damage dealt. Costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Finishing Pass
fusions.desc: Consumes every affliction on the target, dealing 16 damage plus 1.8 times their remaining damage. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health, and that threshold rises with each rank.

fusions.name: Taste of Blood
fusions.desc: Restores 18 health to you. Its healing rises +8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max +40%).

fusions.name: Scent Trail
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
